answer.explanation: The visible log events show steady invocations across all four functions with no errors, timeouts, throttles or out-of-memory markers. Durations are consistent per function (CrudApi about 25-60 ms at 256 MB, Uploader about 85-230 ms at 256 MB, Thumbnailer about 85-200 ms at 1024 MB, Compression about 490-600 ms at 1024 MB), and Max Memory Used stays well below the configured size (at most 112 MB). Nothing in the visible window points to an IAM, configuration, IaC or code anomaly. About 4,015 events were truncated, so this conclusion covers only the visible portion of the window.
